}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== "MP-GW1" and "MANGOPI" are silkscreened on the board top.
===Specifications=== *CPU: [[ArtInChip]] D213ECV @600MHz RISC-V (64-bit) MCU :SoC: Single-core C906 (RV64IMAFDC) • [https://artinchip.com/upload/files/product/20240122/17059003099013022.pdf Datasheet] *Storage: 256MB (QSPI NAND) Flash, :TF card (max.128GB)/MMC card *Memory: 128MB (SiP DDR3) SDRAM *USB: 2x USB 2.0 ports *Network: 2x FE ports (RTL8201F) <!-- 2x 1GbE (RTL8211F) ?? --> *Other: 2x CAN Bus, 2x RS485 (2-pin) *Power Source: 5V via USB (Type-C)
==Links of Interest== *[https://www.cnx-software.com/2023/07/04/risc-v-router-dual-gbe-dual-usb-2-0-can-bus-rs485/ ''MangoPi MPi-GW1 RISC-V router'' on '''CNX-Software''']
